quotes.text: First, adjust the machine: The top pad should be positioned against the top of your thighs.
quotes.closest: First, adjust the machine: The top pad should be positioned against the top of your thighs.

quotes.text: Adjust the position of the back extension so that the pads press against the front of your quads, just below your hip bones.

quotes.text: Hyperextensions are a hip hinge movement, but if you adjust the pad too high, you’ll be doing more of a crunch. And rounding your back too much, especially under heavy weight loads, is not recommended.

quotes.text: To ensure that your hips can bend and your glutes can work properly, make sure to keep the top pad against the top of your thighs.

quotes.text: Step onto the machine and position yourself with your feet shoulder-width apart and your upper thighs against the top pad.

quotes.text: Bend your knees slightly and secure your feet, keeping them in line with your knees.

quotes.text: Your upper body should be hanging off the edge of the machine, with your arms crossed over your chest or your hands behind your head.

quotes.text: Exhale and move up until your shoulders, spine, and hips are in line.

quotes.text: Squeeze your glutes tight and do not over arch your lower spine.

quotes.text: Make sure to keep your movements slow and controlled, and don’t use momentum to swing your body up or down.
